reading.body:
Three open source projects make up this collection, and all three publish under the same Apache-2.0 licence, with a combined 93,964 GitHub stars across mem0, letta, and zep.

mem0 alone accounts for 64,536 of those stars, close to two thirds of the total, describing itself as drop-in memory infrastructure that persists context for AI agents and apps. letta follows with 24,546 stars, framed as a platform for stateful agents that can learn and self-improve over time, and zep trails at 4,882 stars.

That every one of the three tracked projects shares the same permissive licence suggests agent memory tooling has converged on a common distribution model this early in the category's life, unlike categories elsewhere on this site where licence choice splits more evenly. All three repositories show commits within the last two weeks of the generation date, indicating the category remains under active development rather than settled around a single mature standard.
